title: Stochastic $Σ$-convergence in Orlicz setting and Applications
summary: This paper aims to extend the concept of stochastic $Σ$-convergence to the framework of Orlicz-Sobolev spaces in order to deals with coupled stochastic and deterministic homogenization problems in this type of spaces. Thus, this concept is a combination of both well-known $Σ$-convergence [\textit{Acta Math. Sinica, English Series} \textbf{30}(9) 1621-1654] and stochastic two-scale convergence in the mean schemes [\textit{Asympt. Anal. (2025)} \textbf{142}, 291-320].
